a: fixedSeat misses most of the CSS that makes an ancestor the containing block for fixed descendants
fixedSeat measures the containing block from its border box, but fixed children are placed from its padding box
CONTROL_SELECTOR misses `contenteditable="plaintext-only"`, which isEditableTarget counts as editable
keySpecRoute writes, and parseRoute cannot read, a `)` key with an optional modifier
formatShortcut drops an optional shift from the key but draws it as required on leader steps
The property tests' fakeClock fires a timer that an earlier timer in the same advance cleared
b: chordKey keeps a chord's ASCII punctuation, so Mod+1 never fires on AZERTY
fixedSeat misses containers made by `container-type` and `will-change`, so a ghost lands offset
fixedSeat offsets by the border box, but fixed descendants are placed against the padding box
`hover(*)` parses, then silently means `hover(move)`: the leave half of the wildcard is dropped
Which elements count as their own control is answered two ways in one package
